title: Google Quantum AI: Verifiable Quantum Circuit Compilation
headline: Our best graded entry scored 31.69 on 21 November, about 836th; most teams above us copied a newer public entry at about 33.17, and the leader is at 33.74. A 22 November plan sets out the catch-up and our own ideas to pass it.

board.note: Place and score read from the public board CSV on 22 November 2026 at 15:03 UTC. Our score is Kaggle's graded result for the 21 November entry.

entries.note: Read from Kaggle on 22 November 2026: 46 entries in all before 21 November plus that day's one entry; none used yet on 22 November.

next: Catch up to the best public entry (about 33.17) the same day it is approved.
Run the first one-day tests on the ranked new ideas: a narrower chemistry table shape, fewer qubits for the inverse square root, wider chemistry loader batches.
